final class Generated
    implements Constraint
    uses Snapshot
Public API: explicitly declared with @visibility public.

A GENERATED ... AS ( expression ) STORED column constraint: the column always holds the value of an expression of the other columns.

Mirrors CONSTR_GENERATED with raw_expr. The expression is derived where the columns of the table are visible. A generated column can be NULL. The server requires GENERATED ALWAYS: "for a generated column, GENERATED

  • ALWAYS must be specified" is a diagnostic, and so is an expression that

uses another generated column (PG-GENERATED-COLUMN-001). Source: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/17/sql-createtable.html, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/17/ddl-generated-columns.html.
